program.name: High Kicks
program.subject: Kickboxing
program.blurb: Higher kicks: bouts, then hip strength and balance work that lifts the leg higher.
program.about: For higher, cleaner kicks. Kick bouts come first, then straight sets that build the hip strength and balance a high kick needs: standing knee holds, Cossack squats, single-leg work and side-lying adductions. Abs finish every session. Level II brings longer combinations and Level III adds reps.
program.split: Kick bouts & hip strength / kick bouts & balance
